question: Why does Nafsat II tell the imposter-Sufi stories?
proposition: They present Ibn Turka as an enforcer of the Sharīʿa against wayward Sufis, and so as an ally of the Sunnizing state.
reasoning: MK says ‘primarily’ for this purpose; the anecdotes also show a khirqa received, so they are not only rhetoric.
Nafsat II then dismisses Hurufism harshly.
